Method of Attack: Distributed via spam emails disguised as foreclosure notifications with malicious attachments
Malicious attachment contains obfuscated VBA-based macro that downloads ransomware
Ransomware disables Windows startup repair and deletes shadow volume copies
Encrypts victim files with unique random extension
Creates ransom notes with unique keys and payment site links
Ransom payment demanded via Bitcoin on Tor and secondary websites
Discoverer: G DATA malware analyst Sascha Curylo
Attack Vector: Spam email with malicious Word document attachment
